Independent Dijkstra computation and full gap enumeration passed for 24 parameter sets, 84180 gaps; finite check is supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The explicit isolated-gap set, exact b^(n-2) count, and coefficient polynomial completely solve a natural semigroup invariant for arbitrary bases and unbounded embedding dimension. Their motivation comes from established isolated-gap studies (Smith; Singh–Ram) and the central generalized repunit semigroup family. The recursive peak structure gives meaningful parameter-wide arithmetic information absent from generic Frobenius/genus/type formulas; not a narrow arbitrary numerical slice.
